biotools.summary: Quadrupia is a database cataloging G-quadruplexes across a vast collection of genomes, identified through regular expressions and G4hunter methods. The database facilitates the study of G4 structures across the tree of life and includes clusters annotated with taxonomic distributions and structural information.
